rules: The same region may load a different overlay at different campaign dates.
Campaign events may supersede the initialized overlay.
Claims and actual control are separate fields.
Neutral zones and demilitarized zones are rules-bearing regions, not decorative map colors.
Settlement presence, claim, effective control, jurisdiction, sovereignty and recognition are separate inputs; no single colony auto-owns surrounding space.
Procedural border geometry follows procedural_border_derivation_rules_v0.1 and permits gaps, enclaves, corridors and disputed regions.
